## What lives here
Remote deployment targets: the provider catalog, encrypted credentials, diagnostics, SSH and Brev and cloud helpers, provider accounts, and the tool and workflow deployers.

## Conventions
All of it is blocking, so it is called through `asyncio.to_thread`. Secrets are Fernet-encrypted and never returned.

## Entry points
`routes/remote_servers.py` and `deployers.py`.
